Generate Meeting ID from Blind Indian Tech Support Meeting Centre
Open Accessibility settings to enable BITS Tandem Centre
Generate a Meeting ID and give it to the person you want to help. They enter it under Allow access to my phone. You will then see their screen and can control it.

The other person will see your screen and can tap, swipe, and press Back, Home and Recents on your phone. Only share the Meeting ID with someone you trust. You can press Disconnect Connection at any time.
Meeting ID: 7 digits and 1 capital letter
Remote screen. Touch to tap, drag to swipe.
Lets the person you connected with tap, swipe, and press Back, Home and Recents on this phone during a BITS Tandem Centre session. It does not read your screen content.
Your screen is being shared. Tap Disconnect to stop.
